user.title: Add Winston
user.description: On Winston's Ways to talk page, switch on Show him in Home Assistant and select Pair. Type his computer's address and the code it shows.

data_description.host: The address of the computer Winston runs on.
data_description.port: Shown on the Ways to talk page under Home Assistant integration.
data_description.code: Six digits, good for ten minutes.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: Found {name} at {host}. On his Ways to talk page, select Pair and type the code it shows.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer knows this Home Assistant. On his Ways to talk page, select Pair and type the new code.

error.invalid_code: That code is wrong or expired. Make a new one on Winston's Ways to talk page.
error.cannot_connect: Winston did not answer at that address and port. Check that Show him in Home Assistant is on, and that a firewall lets Home Assistant reach the port.

abort.already_configured: This Winston is already added. Its address and pairing are updated.
abort.wrong_winston: That code is from a different Winston.
